text: The sure conviction that we could if we wanted to is the reason so many good minds are idle.
author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg
visual_brief: An orthographic blueprint of a heavy flywheel locked in place by an engaged brake caliper, detailing radial stress lines, torque vectors, and cross-hatched sectional views of the stationary rotor.
alt: Technical blueprint of a stationary flywheel with brake caliper and torque vectors
